issues: [reviewer] Crowded hero CTA stack: three buttons (Call / Get a Free Quote / Explore Services) plus the header Call button and topbar phone all compete in the first viewport. Keep the primary 'Call' + secondary 'Get a Free Quote'; demote 'Explore Services' to a plain text link or remove it (index.html:53-57).

[reviewer] Motion-decor overload undercuts the garage's trust tone: pulsing loader, spinning dashed ring + wrench geometry in the hero (styles.css:104-106), magnetic buttons, word-mask reveals, count-ups, and grain add up to 'award template' rather than 'neighborhood shop'. Replace the abstract ring/wrench visual with real photographic texture (workshop or a quoted-bill motif) and cut the ring spin + magnetic cursor effect.

[reviewer] Hours are dodged everywhere — the Visit section only says 'Hours vary by day — call' (index.html:122) and the topbar echoes it; hours are the top info need for a local repair visitor. Publish a real weekly hours block (or a concrete 'Open today until 6pm' line) in the Visit section.

[reviewer] Redundant triple reassurance in sequence: the marquee band (index.html:68-70) repeating 'One Repair', the four-item trust strip (index.html:71), and the stats row (index.html:72) all re-state the same up-front-quote/warranty claims back-to-back. Keep the strip + stats and cut the marquee, or space them apart.

praise: Copy is specific and confident — real street address, phone, 4.9/83 reviews, 'Diagnostics before dollars', 'approve before we wrench', 'fast scheduling, most jobs within days', no lorem ipsum or generic welcome.

Color restraint is disciplined: navy/gold/orange built from one family, applied consistently across hero, badges, and CTAs; the palette actually whispers 'automotive' instead of default gradient soup.
Type pairing (Archivo Black display + Archivo body) with a proper clamp scale and capped line-length tagline gives a clean rhythm from hero through foot.
Strong one-visit result: name, trade, offer, and phone are unmissable via topbar, sticky header, hero, CTA banner, and footer.
